verdict.rationale: PayPal's docs describe a PayPal button that customers select directly on your site (paypal-docs-37, paypal-docs-2). Expanded Checkout adds card field customization with your business branding (paypal-docs-27), so payment components are embedded and customizable rather than hosted redirects. Evidence is thin on how deep the customization goes and how the components are embedded. Missing for 10: details of the client SDK and component styling options, evidence of embeddable components for native mobile apps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
